question: The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 77 and the third number is 128. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Sum of first three numbers** = (2 × 77) + 128 = 154 + 128 = 282.

**Sum of last two numbers** = Total Sum − Sum of first three = 655 − 282 = 373.

**Average of remaining two** = 373 ÷ 2 = 186.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 186.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Total sum** of 5 numbers = 655

**Average** of the **first two numbers** = 77

**Third number** = 128

**Formula Used:**

**Sum** = **Average** × **Number of observations**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7790f6728a1b2707404d8e741b0a1e42802207678419d8b117e6f671a56d6c56.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Sum** of the **first two numbers** = 77 × 2 = 154

⇒ **Sum** of the **first three numbers** = 154 + 128 = 282

⇒ **Sum** of the **remaining two numbers** = **Total Sum** − **Sum of first three numbers**

⇒ **Sum** of the **remaining two numbers** = 655 − 282 = 373

⇒ **Average** of the **remaining two numbers** = 373 ÷ 2

⇒ **Average** = 186.5

**∴ The correct answer is 186.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Average

The arithmetic mean or average is the ratio of the **Sum of all observations** to the **Total number of observations**.

Combined Average Formula

If two groups have sizes n₁, n₂ and averages A₁, A₂, then **Combined Average** = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Sum from Average

To find the total value when the average is known, use the relation: **Sum** = **Average** × **Count**.</p
